title: Static Oval Fin-Skirt Cuttlefish
description: One original whole stylised cuttlefish-like animal resting low: a long broad oval mantle incorporates a true continuous thin lateral fin skirt in its closed surface, with a closed broad ventral resting patch. A short distinct forward head has large side eyes; eight short tapered forward arms and two longer club-ended tentacles form a front bundle rather than a radial octopus skirt. All mantle cross-sections, fin boundary and appendage paths are new, not an old octopus body stretched or a jellyfish bell rotated. One static prop, zero scenes. Artistic exterior only: no exact species/anatomy, internal shell/gills, suction detail, ink release, feeding, swimming, camouflage, rigging, animation or interaction claimed.
